reviewer: Codex primary final critical reading; separate-reader source findings/limits retained in evidence/reviews for Splitwise, Feed and Cab. No human/Claude technical acceptance claimed.

clarity.evidence: A frozen ranked page order stays stable while current privacy can remove items.

scope.evidence: Post authority differs from inbox references; viewer/session/index-bound cursor advances by scanned candidates. Author fan-in is capped before ranking.

contracts.evidence: Post authority differs from inbox references; viewer/session/index-bound cursor advances by scanned candidates. Author fan-in is capped before ranking.

correctness.evidence: FeedChecks includes 51-author and exact 720-candidate regressions after the separate reader found the missing pre-ranking author cap. Declared capacity arithmetic was separately recomputed.

failure_handling.evidence: Current visibility/deletion/unfollow/block gates each page; empty items can still have continuation; old/foreign/expired cursors fail.

visual_learning.evidence: Three source-generated feed histories show stable pages, filtered empty continuation and cursor lifecycle.

tradeoffs.evidence: Hybrid push/pull, favorite-first then activity author selection, frozen ID sessions versus current permission, production indexed reads versus toy scans.

code.evidence: Complete checked Java21 mechanisms and exact source/excerpt/download parity; actual output in resume-20261027-checks.json and its command logs.

rendering.evidence: HLD-5-browser.json: article/walkthrough in light/dark at 1280/390px with real controls; no page overflow/broken images, table contrast passes; applicable fallbacks tested.

limits: Local Java/fixture/geometry tests and browser observations; no remote provider, bank, distributed durability/failover, production load or model-quality evaluation.
